hook: Six claimants face joint legal costs of up to £34.5 million, but they're challenging the ruling.

sections.voiceover: Six claimants face joint legal costs of up to £34.5 million, but they're challenging the ruling.
b_roll: High Court building exterior in London

sections.voiceover: On November 6, 2026, Prince Harry petitioned the High Court over a privacy dismissal. Why did 6 claimants challenge the High Court order?
b_roll: Legal document displaying petition date November 6 2026
Graphics showing Sir Elton John and Elizabeth Hurley

sections.voiceover: However, in August 2026, Mr Justice Nicklin ordered an initial £9.54 million payment that wasn't final.
b_roll: Court gavel and judgment paper graphic
Financial graphic highlighting £9.54 million initial order

sections.voiceover: Court filings show the group faces joint costs up to £34.5 million. Associated Newspapers won the dismissal against all 6 claimants.
b_roll: Chart depicting joint legal costs total of 34.5 million pounds
BBC News article graphic headline on appeal application
Scale graphic representing court dismissal outcome

sections.voiceover: Elizabeth Hurley and five other claimants petitioned the High Court for permission to appeal.
